climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A New Jersey AVA covering most of Warren County, in several small valleys formed by tributaries of the Delaware River. Most vineyards are on southeast-facing hillsides. It was created in 1988 on a petition from Alba Vineyard and other local growers.
